title: Equinix Issues €2.5 Billion in Green Bonds to Advance Sustainability Initiatives
summary: The proceeds will support investments that strengthen Equinix's sustainability efforts across decarbonization,…...
body_markdown:
*The proceeds will support investments that* *strengthen Equinix's sustainability efforts across decarbonization, resource efficiency and environmental resilience globally*


REDWOOD CITY, Calif.


, Nov. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Equinix, Inc. (Nasdaq: EQIX), the world's digital infrastructure company®, today announced that Equinix Europe 2 Financing Corporation LLC has issued €2.5 billion in aggregate principal amount of green senior notes across four tranches, which carry an effective all-in interest rate of 4.82% per year on a blended basis after the estimated impact of interest rate hedges. The notes are guaranteed by Equinix, Inc. This latest issuance is Equinix's largest green senior notes offering to date and underscores Equinix's continued commitment to integrate sustainability across its business and capital allocation strategies, helping fund projects that deliver measurable environmental impact across its global operations.


The offering closed on November 9, 2026. Including this latest issuance, Equinix has issued more than US$12 billion of green bonds globally, making it one of the top issuers in the investment-grade green bond market.


The proceeds from the offering are expected to be allocated to finance and/or refinance eligible green projects under Equinix's recently updated[Green Finance Framework](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4818794-1&h=1853641639&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.equinix.com%2Fcontent%2Fdam%2Feqxcorp%2Fen_us%2Fdocuments%2Fabout%2Fsustainability%2F2026_green_finance_framework_en.pdf&a=Green+Finance+Framework) , which streamlines the eligible product categories and strengthens the company's approach to sustainable financing in alignment with internationally recognized market standards and best practices. The updated framework focuses investment across eligible project categories including green buildings, renewable and clean energy, energy efficiency, and sustainable water management and watershed resilience initiatives, advancing Equinix's decarbonization and resilience priorities as part of its long-standing commitment to sustainability.


"At Equinix, sustainability is deeply embedded in our business and capital allocation strategy," said Olivier Leonetti, Chief Financial Officer, Equinix. "The strong demand for this offering reflects investor confidence in our long-term growth strategy and supports investments through our Green Finance Framework that help deliver measurable environmental impact while creating lasting value for our customers, communities and stakeholders."


The issuance builds on Equinix's long track record in sustainable finance and follows the recent publication of the company's[2026 Green Bond Allocation and Impact Report](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4818794-1&h=135489832&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.equinix.com%2Fcontent%2Fdam%2Feqxcorp%2Fen_us%2Fdocuments%2Fabout%2Fsustainability%2F2026_Green_Bond_Allocation_and_Impact_Report_en.pdf&a=2026+Green+Bond+Allocation+and+Impact+Report) , which provides transparency into the use and allocation of proceeds from prior green bond issuances. The report also confirms that, as of June 2026, 100% of proceeds from Equinix's outstanding green bond issuances had been allocated, with no remaining unallocated net proceeds.
